description: Source-pinned NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 as a German-capable local ASR challenger. Primary sources support strong upstream German benchmark results, timestamps, NeMo Python chunked-streaming evaluation and an official 714 MB Q8_0 GGUF / NeMo-Speech.cpp local path. Current NeMo-Speech.cpp documentation explicitly marks Parakeet TDT endpointing unsupported/offline-only for streaming endpointing, so no native realtime endpointing, Frankenstein target-runtime or German E2E credit is granted.
